text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- An alliance between oil company Petrogal and the Italian Italgas is possible to buy a stake in gas company GDL - Gas de Lisboa. Petrogal also intends to increase its position on the capital of the distribution regional companies.

- Portugal believes that the Maastricht Treaty would allow Germany, France and Italy to enter monetary union even if their deficits were slightly above 3.0 percent of gross domestic product, Prime Minister Antonio Guterres says in interview. Portugal also has some reservations in accepting the 'general flexibility clause' to be discussed at the Amsterdam sumit.

- The privatisation of 30 pct of the capital of state electricity company EDP - Electricidade de Portugal starts today. According to analists, a rise of 20 to 30 percent in the value of the company's shares is predicted almost immediately.
- Health Minister Maria de Belem is going to reform a system too dependent on subsidies.

- China Telecom is putting finishing touches to negotiations that will allow it control of Macau Telecomunications Company (CTM). The business will be concluded by the end of the year, according to Portugal Telecom, which owns 28 percent of CTM.

- Prime minister Antonio Guterres says European Union should have an economic pillar as strong as the monetary union one and a declaration dedicated to the creation of jobs and to the economic growth should be included on the stability pact.

- 'Except for local calls, the prices of comunications in Portugal are among the highest in the European Union and the quality of the services is inferior to the union standard", a study from the Ministry of Social Equipment says.
